verdict.rationale: Stable documents keyword-based auto-routing, tags, AI summaries and Slack/email alerts, and its registered agent page says it gives instant access to state and legal mail with automated routing to act on it quickly. That covers getting government and legal mail to the right people, but nothing documents automatic flagging or prioritization of IRS, state or service-of-process mail, or deadline tracking. Missing for 10: explicit flagging or prioritization of government and legal mail, compliance-deadline detection or reminders, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an operator, government and legal mail — IRS, state filings, service of process — is flagged or prioritized so a compliance deadline never sits unread in the pile

citations.quote: Auto-route mail to the right team based on key words found inside the mail, on the envelope, and more.
Stable gives you instant digital access to state and legal mail along with the automated routing and collaboration tools to act on it quickly.
Gain complete visibility into your mail with tags and audit logs.
Notify: Tailor Slack or email alerts about new mail to your preference.
